facts.fact: A tender notice dated 10 August 2026 seeks consultants to support the Data Protection Commission in developing regulatory instruments for the effective implementation of the Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021, treating the Act as the law being implemented.
The same tender names the Data Protection Commission as the body it will support in reviewing and developing regulatory instruments, treating it as an existing body.
